restriction_review.learning: Selected rows show no mandatory learning or explicit minimum; ordinary experimentable metadata.
restriction_review.containers: Three dough recipes use MixingBowl14; all pies/tarts/slices use Oven/Spit15, ten-slot bowl/oven and six-slot spit retained. Only one-unit slicing rows list spit.
restriction_review.returns: Ten tarts return the exact MuffinTin13437 on success/failure, salvage0.
restriction_review.yield_outliers: Taelosian Lemon-Orange Tart and Taelosian Wildberry Mountain Tart yield1, other tarts yield6; source outliers retained, not normalized.
restriction_review.slicing: Nine source15 No-Fail slicing recipes; Lemon-Orange slice yields1 and eight others yield8; no native/historical nofail certification.
restriction_review.era: Maintained PoR category/current primary item pages; not immutable May2013 numeric receipts.
restriction_review.identity: All53 required output/component/return/portable-container identities verified through retained hashed primary HTML.
restriction_review.producer_dependencies: Three missing pastry dough producers included. Five fruit fillings belong to RRC016; exact full recipe/logical-entry guards on apply/reapply before/after insertion; no modification to producers.
